field.label: Enable MCP Server
field.comment: Serves read-only commerce tools (product search, product cards, categories, store info) to AI agents at POST /mcp. Tools expose only what an anonymous shopper already sees. Add a full-page-cache bypass for /mcp — see the README for Varnish/LiteSpeed snippets.

field.label: Require Bearer Token
field.comment: When Yes, every request must carry an Access Token of an active Integration (a customer token alone is not enough) (System → Extensions → Integrations, grant it the MCP Server Agent Access resource). Revoking the integration instantly cuts agent access.

field.label: Log Agent Calls
field.comment: One JSON line per agent tool call in var/log/angeo_mcp_agent.jsonl (timestamp, tool, user agent, duration — never payloads or tokens). This is the data source for agent-traffic analytics.

group.label: Claude Connector
group.comment: Lets shoppers connect this store to Claude in one click. Paste the connector URL your MCP provider issued you, then place the generated button anywhere on the storefront.

field.label: Connector URL
field.comment: The HTTPS MCP endpoint shoppers connect to, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/t/your-store/mcp. Leave empty to hide the button. This is not your store's own /mcp path — that endpoint has no OAuth and cannot be added to Claude directly.

field.label: Connector Name
field.comment: Shown to the shopper in Claude's connector list. Defaults to the store name.

group.label: Agent presentation
group.comment: What an AI client reads about this store when it connects, before it decides whether to use your tools at all. These settings do not change what the tools do — they change how findable they are.

field.label: Store name for agents
field.comment: How the store is named to an AI client, e.g. "Acme Outdoor". Leave empty to use the store view name (or the website name when the store view is still called something generic like "Default Store View"). This is the name a shopper has to type for the model to match their request to this connector, so use the name customers actually know you by.

field.label: Agent instructions (override)
field.comment: Optional. Replaces the instructions sent to AI clients on connect. Leave empty to generate them from the store name and the tools actually installed — the generated text stays correct when you add or remove the checkout module, a hand-written one will not.

field.label: Add store name to tool descriptions
field.comment: Appends "Applies to the {store} store only." to every tool description. Helps a client tell your tools apart from another shop's when a shopper has several connectors enabled.

field.label: Generate tool titles
field.comment: Sets a human-readable title annotation on each tool ("Search Acme Outdoor products") for the client's permission screen. Without it clients show generic labels that read identically for every connected shop.

field.label: Price Customer Group
field.comment: Customer group whose prices agents see. Default: NOT LOGGED IN.

field.label: Max Page Size
field.comment: Hard protocol cap is 100.

field.label: Rate Limit (requests/minute)
field.comment: Per client IP (plus token, when present). 0 disables the limiter.

field.label: Accept Customer Tokens
field.comment: Lets tools act for a signed-in shopper (their own orders and cart). A connector sends the shopper's MCP-only token from Account Linking as X-Customer-Token, next to its Integration token. Leave No unless a module that needs it is installed, such as angeo/module-mcp-reorder.

field.label: Accept Storefront Customer Tokens (testing)
field.comment: Also accept ordinary Magento customer tokens (from REST login) at /mcp, e.g. for testing with Claude Code. Leave No in production. Such tokens were issued for the store's REST and GraphQL APIs, not for MCP; the MCP specification says servers must not accept them. Connectors use Account Linking, which issues MCP-only tokens.

field.label: Allowed Browser Origins
field.comment: Requests from a browser carry an Origin header; unknown origins get HTTP 403 (DNS-rebinding protection, required by the MCP transport). The store's own URLs are always allowed. AI platforms connect server-to-server without an Origin and are not affected. One origin per line, e.g. http://localhost:6274 for the MCP Inspector.

group.label: Account Linking
group.comment: Lets a signed-in shopper connect their store account to an AI assistant through an MCP connector (for example mcp.angeo.dev). The shopper signs in on this store and approves; the connector never sees the password. Shoppers see and disconnect their assistants under My Account → AI assistants. Needs Security → Accept Customer Tokens = Yes.

field.label: Connector Redirect URIs
field.comment: Where the shopper is sent back after approving, one per line, compared exactly. HTTPS only. Your connector provider gives you this value, e.g. https://mcp.angeo.dev/authorize/linked.

field.label: Connector Name Shown to Shoppers
field.comment: e.g. "Claude via angeo.dev". Shown on the approval page and in My Account.

field.label: MCP Token Lifetime (minutes)
field.comment: Lifetime of the MCP-only token a connector holds for a shopper. It works at /mcp only, together with the connector's Integration token, and stops at once when the shopper disconnects. 5 – 1440, default 60.

field.label: Strict MCP Headers
field.comment: MCP 2026-07-28 requests must send MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method and, for tool calls, Mcp-Name. Yes rejects requests that omit them, as the specification requires. Headers that contradict the body are rejected either way. Set No only for a proxy that drops these headers. Older clients (2025-11-25 and before) are not affected.

field.label: Tool List Cache Hint (seconds)
field.comment: How long 2026-07-28 clients may cache tools/list and prompts/list. 0 = do not cache. Max 86400.
